question.prompt: \(X\) takes the values \(0\) and \(1\) with probabilities \(3/4\) and \(1/4\), respectively. What is the mean?

solutions.explanation:
The mean is the sum of each possible value multiplied by its probability:
\[
E[X]=0\cdot\frac34+1\cdot\frac14=\frac14.
\]
solutions.title: Probability-weighted mean
